classes.label: Red Hat configiq (scored by simulation)
classes.note: Red Hat's configiq dataset (CC BY 4.0), scored by simulation: each row is simulated as a closed loop at its recorded concurrency and request count, with the substitutions named below. configiq is anchor-only: every row is an anchor row and none is fit, selected, validated, held or withheld as a test set. Provisional: graded no better than G3 and outside the headline. TPOT is GuideLLM's median (it counts the first token) and ITL its mean (the per-request time per output token after the first). First-token time (TTFT) is not shown as an accuracy figure, because its definition (client-side delay) is unconfirmed; that was decided on the clarity of the data, before any error was looked at, and nothing else is hidden.
